from: results/ab-automem-2026-11-02.json (558 sessions, the committed checks of eval/ab/tasks-automem.mjs) and the audit of every miss
method: Every task session the committed check marked not followed (106 of 360, all five arms) was read by hand against its task's `follows` sentence, written before the run, on the session's final project rebuilt from its transcript (the project as set up, then each successful Write, Edit and MultiEdit in order). The rebuilds were checked first: the committed checks, rerun on all 360 rebuilt projects, gave the recorded verdict and note in 360 of 360. Rule tasks keep the design's rule: followed when the forbidden change is never attempted, whether or not the guard refused it. Only misses were read; a check that wrongly says followed was not looked for.
convention: As scripts/ab-automem-report.mjs counts: a session that failed (the harness's 10-minute limit, no result event) is left out of the judged count, so auto's long-project count is of 17.
